registration: The first live promotion occurred in the last precommitted wave. Register a separate extension after that decision, before viewing the original final grades, before generating the extension data and before any descendant outcomes. Original final panel remains evaluation-only.
question: Can this actual promoted planner, using its own training feedback, produce a useful second generation?
inheritance: Start at the actual promoted wave-three coefficients. Reconstruct equal-task memory from six historic traces, the parents that executed waves one and two, and the two actual feedback histories of the promoted policy on wave three. Replace those last two parent records with its own rather than counting the same tasks twice. Never use outer scores, predictions, or histories of the three original final tasks. Use the existing proposer and exact inherited step after the recorded outcomes. Freeze parent, step, twelve trace hashes and child before both challenges.

tests.source: Original UCI 331 Yelp restaurant sentence polarity, unique non-conflicting normalized sentences, full local source file.

1000 numeric rows from a two-regime simulated sensor task. A continuous context switches the label between an additive signal and a product threshold, with 9% symmetric label flips and nuisance channels. Generator seed 655408.

split_and_process: Stratified 25% outside each solver, seed 655407. Same previously frozen solver, limits (16 including all redos and full refits, 600 seconds, model API 0), raw input, fixed seed and train-only feedback in both arms; restart and verify exported predictions in a new process. Seal all four outputs before opening either set of test labels. Use exactly the registered main quality/efficiency gate; report both tasks independently.
if_promoted: Evaluate parent vs second generation on two additional separate cases, without any further mutation or selection: all UCI Iris classification rows (macro F1) and 1000 synthetic categorical records from a hidden ordering and a third-column exception, generator seed 655409 (balanced accuracy). Same disjoint outer split procedure. Both sets of predictions frozen before scoring. Do not replace the original final panel with this extension.
if_rejected: Keep the first generation as the development incumbent and report no observed second promotion; do not reuse either challenge for a retuned retry.
scope: A fixed, human-specified bounded update and selection mechanism with machine-produced rule coefficients and run-time decisions. This does not test self-rewriting programs, open-ended recursion or formal course test performance.
